tooltip.tacz_wall_display.place: Legacy decorative items can no longer be placed.
tooltip.tacz_wall_display.restore: Legacy decorative items restore their original gun when loaded.
chat.tacz_wall_display.join_hint: [TACZ Wall Display] Press [%s] to toggle gun placement mode. While enabled, hold a TaCZ gun and right-click a block to place it. Firing is disabled in placement mode.
chat.tacz_wall_display.join_hint_unbound: [TACZ Wall Display] Bind Toggle free gun placement mode in Options > Controls > Key Binds. While enabled, hold a TaCZ gun and right-click a block to place it. Firing is disabled in placement mode.
chat.tacz_wall_display.join_hint_config: In %s, set %s to hide this message.
hud.tacz_wall_display.cannot_fire: Cannot fire in gun placement mode!
config.tacz_wall_display.cacheDecorative: Keep model and GPU caches across dimensions until disconnect or resource reload. Uses more memory/VRAM. Disabling clears existing caches once, then releases them on dimension changes; the active scene still uses temporary rendering caches.
config.tacz_wall_display.maxRenderDistan: Maximum decorative-gun render distance in blocks: 1–512. -1 removes this addon's distance limit; chunks must still be loaded.
config.tacz_wall_display.showPlacementHi: Show placement controls in chat once per world/server connection. Does not repeat on respawn or dimension changes.
